description: A shell script that sets up the 'binder' tools by cloning a Git repository, configuring the environment PATH, and verifying the installation.

methods.name: clone_repo
methods.description: Checks if the repository is already cloned; if not, clones the 'linux_binder_idl' repository from GitHub into the designated install directory.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Checks if the binder tools directory is in the system PATH; if not, suggests how to add it permanently.

methods.name: verify_installation
methods.description: Verifies whether the 'binder' command is available in PATH, indicating successful installation.

methods.name: check_sourced
methods.description: Checks if the script was run in a sourced manner and warns the user accordingly.
